title: The Superhuman World of Wim Hof: The Iceman
summary: A VICE documentary profiling Wim Hof, the Iceman, covering his feats of cold endurance, his breathing and meditation method, and scientific studies of his control over his autonomic and immune systems.
why: HN mentions it as evidence that the Wim Hof method can be learned and as the documentary that led some to try breathing and cold exposure, while others dispute the claims.

quote.text: tried the breathing: and cold showers and they've been helping a lot with inflammation!
